_comment: Recipes for the fixed walker-terrain courses (see vnl_experiments/envs/walker_courses.py). Unlisted terrain keys take default_terrain_config() values, which match the walker-terrain-factors runs (block_length 0.25, block_halfheight 0.5, start_gap 2). Regenerate the .npz files with `python -m vnl_experiments.envs.walker_courses make`; changing a recipe changes the course sha and so every activations_dmc spec_id that uses it.
